author: Cathy Gellis
description: The Supreme Court has now issued its decision in Cox Communications v. Sony Music Entertainment. This was a case where Cox, a broadband provider, had been held liable for the alleged copyright infringements of its users, in this case via filesharing. It appealed, arguing that such secondary liability was not something that copyright law allowed. […]
title: With Cox V. Sony The Supreme Court Provides Yet Another Internet-Protecting Decision
